_label: Per-state cattle inputs from EPA (2025) Inventory 1990-2023 (EPA 430-R-25-003) Annex 3.11, 2022 values. Replaces v1 placeholders.

_assumptions.liquid_slurry->liquid_nocrust: ASSUMED: EPA 'liquid/slurry' mapped to IPCC liquid slurry without natural crust
_assumptions.deep_pit->liquid_nocrust: ASSUMED: EPA 'deep pit' mapped to IPCC liquid slurry (6-month, 2019) because pit storage is not a livingghg system
_assumptions.anaerobic_digester: ASSUMED: EPA anaerobic-digester share removed and remaining shares renormalised (digester CH4 not modelled)
_assumptions.mcf_zone: ASSUMED: one MCF zone for all states (IPCC2006 15C; IPCC2019 cool_temperate_moist); state climate not yet mapped
_assumptions.ym_category: IPCC table category used only if fork F013 = ipcc_default
_assumptions.scope: Mature cows only (milk cows; beef cows = EPA 'beef NOF cows'). Heifers, steers, calves, bulls, feedlot cattle NOT included.
